title: The weaponisation ladder
subtitle: The cyber desk's reading as a strip: which rungs php2shell has reached, and which would move it up. 8 panels.
rule: Every line a character says is the storyboard's own words, not a quote, and is marked not_a_quote; every evidence panel quotes this site's data word for word and names the file (quote_from), which the gate checks; every panel cites the evidence vault's source slugs it rests on (cites), which the gate checks against the manifest.

scenes.title: The weaponisation ladder
scenes.subtitle: From private exploits to ransomware, seven rungs
scenes.note: Drawn from the cyber desk's piece, 'Patch at the speed of Metasploit', written against the source watch at 17:51 UTC on 22 October.

scenes.caption: Capability is not commodity

cast.says: Not yet. It still needs knowledge of the target.

scenes.note: Log4Shell and Shellshock worked with one request, everywhere; php2shell, today, needs the right configuration.

scenes.caption: Rungs 1 to 4: reached
scenes.note: Calif, OpenAI and Wiz in August; a honeypot hit on 17 October; hundreds of GitHub repositories, which Sansec says fail on default installs; version-fingerprint scanning.

scenes.caption: Rungs 5 to 7: not reached
scenes.note: A Metasploit pull request is open and not merged; neither flaw is in KEV; no evidence of monetisation.

scenes.caption: Rung 7 is the one to hold on to

cast.says: Both earlier PHP flaws in KEV ended up with ransomware.

scenes.note: Configuration-dependent changes how many victims there are, not whether someone eventually monetises the bug.

scenes.caption: How fast KEV moved before
scenes.note: From the cyber desk's ladder table: Log4Shell and MOVEit on day one, CVE-2024-4577 three days after.

scenes.caption: What would move it up a rung

cast.says: So we watch for the artefacts.

scenes.note: The cyber desk watches each of these hourly through the source watch (board item 079).

scenes.punchline: Patch before it needs no skill.
scenes.note: "Patch at the speed of Metasploit": the time that matters is disclosure to the moment exploitation stops needing skill.
